comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Feature 0 requires an explicit quotation of a specific OP phrase plus a dispute of that quoted text, so quotation is required. Feature 1 requires a challenge to an underlying assumption or premise, and it excludes comments that only dispute facts or the conclusion. Neither needs the other: a quote-and-refute can target a conclusion or fact, and a premise challenge needs no quote. Their null rules also differ: 0 returns null if the OP text needed to verify the quote is missing, while 1 returns null only if both title and argument are missing.
